lines.beaver: 어, 민수야! 이게 얼마 만이야? 진짜 반갑다.
lines.beaver_en: Hey, Minsu! How long has it been? So good to see you.
lines.beaver_roman: eo, minsuya! ige eolma maniya? jinjja bangapda.
lines.en: I hear you're famous at work these days?

lines.beaver: 에이, 아니야. 그냥 열심히 일할 뿐이야.
lines.beaver_en: Nah, not really. I just work hard.
lines.beaver_roman: ei, aniya. geunyang yeolsimhi ilhal ppuniya.
lines.learner: 아내가 외국 사람이라면서? 어느 나라 사람이야?
lines.en: I hear your wife is a foreigner? Where is she from?
lines.roman: anaega oeguk saramiramyeonseo? eoneu nara saramiya?

lines.beaver: 응, 캐나다 사람이야. 한국어도 아주 잘해.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, she's Canadian. She speaks Korean really well, too.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, kaenada saramiya. hangugeodo aju jalhae.
lines.en: I hear you had a baby last year? Congratulations!

lines.beaver: 고마워. 벌써 돌이 지났어. 작년 봄에 태어났거든.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. He's already past his first birthday. He was born last spring.
lines.beaver_roman: gomawo. beolsseo dori jinasseo. jangnyeon bome taeeonatgeodeun.
lines.en: Wow, already one year old. It's a boy, right?

lines.beaver: 맞아. 얼굴은 동양인 같기도 하고 서양인 같기도 해.
lines.beaver_en: Right. His face looks both Asian and Western.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. eolgureun dongyangin gatgido hago seoyangin gatgido hae.
lines.learner: 사진 보여 줘! 여동생은 이제 다 컸다면서?
lines.en: Show me a photo! I hear your sister is all grown up now?
lines.roman: sajin boyeo jwo! yeodongsaengeun ije da keotdamyeonseo?

lines.beaver: 응, 벌써 대학생이야. 남동생은 지금 사춘기고.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, she's in college already. My brother's in puberty now.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, beolsseo daehaksaengiya. namdongsaengeun jigeum sachungigo.
lines.learner: 아, 그 남동생이 중학생이라면서? 사춘기라 힘들겠다.
lines.en: Oh, your brother's in middle school, right? Puberty must be tough.
lines.roman: a, geu namdongsaengi junghaksaengiramyeonseo? sachungira himdeulgetda.

lines.beaver: 말도 마. 요즘 한마디만 해도 화를 내.
lines.beaver_en: Don't even ask. He gets mad at a single word these days.
lines.beaver_roman: maldo ma. yojeum hanmadiman haedo hwareul nae.
lines.learner: 다 그럴 때지. 우리도 그 나이 때 그랬잖아.
lines.en: That's just the age. We were the same back then.
lines.roman: da geureol ttaeji. urido geu nai ttae geuraetjana.

lines.beaver: 하하, 맞아. 너희 집 어르신들도 잘 계시지?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, true. Are your elders doing well too?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, maja. neohui jip eoreusindeuldo jal gyesiji?
lines.learner: 응, 부모님 다 잘 계셔. 고마워.
lines.en: Yeah, my parents are both doing well. Thanks.
lines.roman: eung, bumonim da jal gyesyeo. gomawo.

lines.beaver: 벌써 시간이 이렇게 됐네. 이제 가 봐야겠다.
lines.beaver_en: Look at the time already. I should get going.
lines.beaver_roman: beolsseo sigani ireoke dwaenne. ije ga bwayagetda.
lines.en: Okay. Even if we're busy, let's meet again soon.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 다음엔 우리 아들도 데리고 올게.
lines.beaver_en: Sure. Next time I'll bring my son too.
lines.beaver_roman: joa. daeumen uri adeuldo derigo olge.
lines.learner: 응, 그 귀여운 녀석 꼭 보고 싶다. 잘 가!
lines.en: Yes, I really want to meet the cute little guy. Bye!
lines.roman: eung, geu gwiyeoun nyeoseok kkok bogo sipda. jal ga!
